events.content:
Added view transitions to the product gallery. A product’s color-block image now morphs between its grid thumbnail and detail view; the gallery and detail pages slide in opposite directions for forward and back links. Suspense skeletons fade and move into their content, and `prefers-reduced-motion` disables those animations and the skeleton pulse.

The changes use React’s `ViewTransition` API, so [React and React DOM](/workspace/package.json) were updated to 19.3.1. The transition code is in [PageTransition.tsx](/workspace/app/PageTransition.tsx), the two pages, and [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css).

`npm run build` and `git diff --check` pass. I did not run a visual browser test.
